instructions. Traditional software follows rules written by a programmer. Machine-learning systems can
instead learn statistical patterns from examples. This makes them useful when the number of possible

6. Deep Learning and Neural Networks
Deep learning is a branch of machine learning that uses neural networks with many layers. These
networks are inspired loosely by the connected structure of biological neurons, although artificial neurons
are mathematical functions rather than realistic brain cells. Each layer transforms its input and passes the
result to the next layer.

Deep learning has achieved strong results in computer vision, speech recognition, natural language
processing, and scientific applications. However, it often requires substantial data and computing
resources. Large models can be difficult to interpret and may reproduce patterns or biases present in their
training data.

Natural Language Processing (NLP) is the area of AI that enables computers to work with human
language. Language is complex because words can have multiple meanings, grammar varies, and
meaning depends on context, culture, and situation. NLP combines computational linguistics, machine

8. Computer Vision
Computer vision is the field of AI that enables computers to interpret visual information from images and
videos. A computer vision system may identify objects, locate people, classify scenes, read text, estimate
movement, or inspect products for defects. Cameras and other sensors provide the visual input.
Image classification assigns a label to an entire image. Object detection identifies objects and estimates

patterns such as edges, shapes, and textures. Vision transformers and other architectures have also
become important. Training usually requires labelled images or other learning signals, along with careful
evaluation on data that represents real deployment conditions.
